note: Domain 4 Sustainability & circular economy configuration (demo defaults, editable at later stages). Values are configuration data, NOT industrial calibration claims; each entry keeps sme_pending=true until SME calibration. Mirror contract: mirror/sustainability_domain4_mirror.py. Rule logic lives in the mirror; this file carries only tunable parameters. Boundary contract (foundations_definitions.md B): by-product streams (slag, dust, scale) live as Losses until the sustainability domain converts them to sellable outputs — then they move from Losses to Products. Energy is NOT material: it lives in a separate energy ledger and never enters the material balance. Stable asset IDs reuse the existing set (eaf, drp, cc, bar_mill, wire_rod_mill, crane) — no competing representations.

byproduct_streams.unit: fraction of per-asset input mass (t/t); price and handling USD per tonne
byproduct_streams.note: Slag to cement industry. 40 kg/t steel = 4% of input mass (demo, sme_pending). Handling cost is the trade-off against by-product revenue.

byproduct_streams.unit: fraction of per-asset input mass (t/t); price and handling USD per tonne
byproduct_streams.note: EAF dust to treatment / zinc recovery. 12 kg/t steel = 1.2% of input mass (demo, sme_pending). Off-route assets contribute zero — no double counting.

byproduct_streams.unit: fraction of per-asset input mass (t/t); price and handling USD per tonne
byproduct_streams.note: Rolling-mill scale (cc/bar_mill/wire_rod_mill). Demo value, sme_pending. Sells only when the sustainability domain converts it to a product (boundary contract B).

byproduct_streams.unit: fraction of per-asset input mass (t/t); unsellable loss stream
byproduct_streams.note: Oxidation loss boundary (EAF/DRP). NOT a sellable by-product — stays in Losses. Included so the stage boundaries are explicit and the balance closes without double counting.

carbon.unit: intensity t CO2 per t steel per asset; tax USD per t CO2; bonus/penalty USD per t steel
carbon.note: DRI-EAF route industry-plausible ranges: EAF ~0.6-0.8 t/t on gas (demo 0.70), DRP ~1.0-1.3 t/t (demo 1.15); downstream assets small. Green upgrade (capex) lowers per-asset intensity; plant average below green_threshold earns bonus, above earns penalty. All demo values, sme_pending.

green_premium.unit: premium and REC revenue USD per tonne sold
green_premium.note: Green-flagged product earns premium only when plant-average carbon intensity is below the threshold (threshold-based, config-editable policy assumption). REC revenue is a SEPARATE stream from the premium. Demo values, sme_pending.

energy_recovery.unit: recovered energy GJ/t and kWh/t steel per asset; KPI baseline GJ/t
energy_recovery.note: Recovered energy reduces the energy KPI only. Energy is NOT material: it never enters the material balance (separate energy ledger). kWh->GJ conversion factor fixed at 0.0036 (physics constant, not a commercial assumption). Demo values, sme_pending.
